en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘A divorce of the Sunnah is when the woman is pure, so he divorces her in one place, from without copulation, keeping witnesses upon her divorce. So when he intends to revert to her, he should keep witnesses upon the return’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has said the following: “

Divorce according to Sunnah takes place when the woman is clean of Hayd (menses) and is divorced in her place in the presence of witnesses without sexual intercourse. If he decides to go back to her he must arrange for witness to his going back (reversing his pronouncement of divorce).’”
